$comment: Who owns each piece of data between the 639 vCAOC and DKS. owner=caoc: the CAOC is the source, DKS shows it and must not let planners change it (locked). owner=squadron: planned in DKS, the CAOC reads it back. owner=caoc_only: never sent to DKS. dks: the DKS object/field it lands in (seen = observed in DKS 28 Oct 2026, guess = to confirm). See CONTRACT.md.

layers.flight: one flight, planned by its squadron in DKS
